t: You are at Carlton House Terrace, in St James's, where two grand terraces of white stucco-faced houses overlook The Mall and St. James's Park. They were built on Crown land between 1827 and 1832 to overall designs by John Nash, with detailed input from other architects including Decimus Burton, and James Pennethorne oversaw construction. Both blocks are Grade I listed. Carlton Gardens is at the western end. Sarah Greville, Countess of Warwick, wife of the 3rd Earl of Warwick, died here in 1851. Dharam Hinduja, son of Srichand Hinduja, lived here.
